inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_1: Use an Enchanting Table as the heart of your altar. This example shows the default Sharpness I recipe.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_2: Two ordinary bookshelves provide the 2 Bookshelf Power needed here. Default scan: 5 blocks horizontally and 2 vertically.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_3: Store a Sharpness I or higher book in the Chiseled Bookshelf. Learning a recipe never replaces this physical reference book.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_4: Place one amethyst shard on each side pedestal and one iron ingot on the front pedestal. One item per pedestal; at most eight. Default pedestal radius: 4 blocks.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_5: Right-click the table with a compatible item to place your target.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_6: Shift + right-click to start Infusion. This recipe takes 5 seconds and uses no XP or lapis.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_7: The sword receives Sharpness I and the reagents are consumed. The reference book has a 10%% consumption chance in this default recipe.
inscribed.ponder.enchanting_setup.text_8: Right-click with an empty main hand to retrieve the enchanted item. Check the Guide or JEI: modpacks can change ingredients, power and chances.
